title: Mirepoix
description: A classic French aromatic vegetable base of onion, carrot, and celery used to build flavor in stocks, soups, sauces, stews, and braised dishes.

items: Onion – 50% of the mix (about 2 parts), diced
Carrot – 25% of the mix (about 1 part), diced
Celery – 25% of the mix (about 1 part), diced
1 tbsp butter or olive oil (optional, for sweating)

instructions: Wash, peel if necessary, and dice the onion, carrot, and celery into uniform pieces.
Heat butter or olive oil in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over low to medium heat, if using.
Add the vegetables and sweat gently without browning for 5–10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Use the mirepoix as the flavor base for stocks, soups, sauces, stews, braises, or roasts.
For stocks, combine the mirepoix with a bouquet garni to create a rich, balanced flavor foundation.
chefTips: Maintain the classic French ratio of 2:1:1 (onion:carrot:celery) for balanced flavor.
Sweat the vegetables gently—avoid browning unless the recipe specifically calls for it.
Cut vegetables evenly to ensure consistent cooking and flavor extraction.
Pair mirepoix with a bouquet garni for authentic Continental and French cooking.
